headline.tier: v11 Concept Pool Architecture: 16 pools, 5-seed validated bidirectional binding
headline.result: 4x diversity over 4-motor-pool ceiling; A->W 98.75% unanimous; W->A 56%
headline.metrics: Phase 1 W->A: 9.0/16 mean (56%) std 1.5 across 5 seeds. Phase 3 A->W: 79/80 = 98.75% (only seed 45 lost 1 of 16). Every concept pool deterministically speaks its trained word in nearly all seeds.
headline.wall_clock: ~17 min/seed training + 1min A->W eval (2048 lang_input, 200 per pool, 16 concepts)
headline.summary: Concept pool architecture (4 motor + 4 noun + 4 verb + 4 adjective = 16 pools) extends Tier 1 recipe to non-direction concepts. 11-iteration debugging arc identified 7 architectural bugs (FS asymmetry, STDP leakage, canon dynamics, topographic strength, multiplicative dampening, one-directional bias, scale-vs-diversity tradeoff). v11 production recipe: weak dynamics + interleaved + target-priority topographic 3.0/0.3 + reciprocal bias + adjective pools. Multi-seed 5/5 confirms scale: bidirectional binding (A->W 98.75%) + meaningful W->A (56% with low std). v9 12-pool was 52%; adding adjectives IMPROVED rate. v12 dlpfc_verb integration NEGATIVE (broke A->W via PFC feedback). Sequential composition remains open (single-pool persistence needs more careful design).

pillars.metric: A2W any-synonym mean 87.5% +/- 20.9% (6/6 above 50%, 5/6 at 100%); paper's 6/6 aligned reproduces and exceeds (paper was 63.7% +/- 11.8%); STDP WTA primary-wins confirmed at production-side (synonym top-1 0% across all seeds)

pillars.name: 64-word smoke — capacity rule extends to 16 sub-pops/motor_X
pillars.metric: pre-silence primary 62.5% (anchor binding scales to 64-word vocab!); retention primary 76% (just under 80% threshold); retention synonym 157% (anomalous, secondaries IMPROVE post-hippo-silence)

pillars.name: STP DEFAULT FLIPPED — 3.28x faster + accuracy improved
pillars.metric: 3-seed validation: wall clock 506s vs 1660s (3.28x); A2W primary 100% vs 87.5% (+12.5pp); W2A 52% vs 35% (+17pp). STP was 57% of inner-loop step time AND degrading binding via millisecond synaptic fatigue. Default flipped in chat training paths.

pillars.name: Encoding-axis 64-word 3-seed — capacity rule revised
pillars.metric: 3/3 GO unanimous. Retention primary 110% +/- 23%, synonym 119% +/- 34%. Wall clock 954s +/- 7s (35x faster than prior 9.4 hr baseline). User's encoding-vs-motor hypothesis confirmed: n_motor=2000 + n_lang=8192 outperforms n_motor=6000 + n_lang=4096 at 64-word vocab. New rule: lang_input encoding is rate-limiting, not motor capacity.

capacity_rule.rule: REVISED 2026-05-10: encoding-axis architecture recommended for vocab >= 32. Motor capacity matters less than encoding capacity at higher vocab tiers. Encoding (n_lang_input) is rate-limiting; motor pool just needs ~125 neurons/sub-pop to support STDP convergence.

phase_status.active: Encoding-axis architecture VALIDATED 3-seed. Combined opt stack: STP-off + encoding-axis = 35x speedup AND better retention. Recommended baseline for vocab >= 32 words. Capacity rule revised. Tier 2.3 phrases needs STP-off revalidation (silent flip risk).
phase_status.next: Launch 128-word + 256-word encoding-axis smokes (~30-60 min each) to validate true encoding-wall ceiling. Re-run Tier 2.3 phrases at STP-off (architecture was limited at 41% with STP-on; STP-off may improve or degrade).
phase_status.after_next: Re-validate prior Tier 1 + Tier 2.1 + Phase 1.4 multi-seed results at STP-off + new architecture. Predicted to push numbers significantly higher.
